title: CertCentral
tagline: Cert Central is an Talent appreciation and recognition platform, where entities like Corporates, Institutions will certify the participates with NFTs. The NFTs contributes to the participates profile and certify their skill set.
description:
In  the centralised world, each individual declares their achievements on professional website.

The cert central is a platform targeted to change that. Instead of each individual building their own profile, the recognised entities like companies or universities will evaluate and declare the level of expertise as NFT.

As the individual grows in the organisation, or learns new skill sets, they are listed on their profile by the involved organisation.

This approach will eliminate the need to do back ground checks as every participation is recorded on the blockchain. The organisation has full flexibility to capture as much details as possible to support the NFT issued.

This can be considered as another incentive from the employer. The NFTs are stored on file coin and the storage contracts needs to be renewed. As such,  current employer or new employer can offer this storage and renewal as part of the employee compensation model
how_its_made:
The Project uses Hardhat suite for developing, testing and deployments.

The project is developed in solidity as of now with some testing.
Once the smart contracts are tested to the extent of basic functionality,
the front end will be developed in NextJS.

The project is developed in solidity as of now with testing to validate the smart contracts. Once the smart contracts are completed tested for all the scenarios, then the front end will be developed in NextJS.
